tasks.label: Run Printly API with local MongoDB
Create local test account
tasks.command: $env:MONGODB_URI='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/printly'; node --import tsx --input-type=module -e 'import mongoose from "mongoose"; import bcrypt from "bcryptjs"; import { User } from "./server/src/models/User.ts"; import { Shop } from "./server/src/models/Shop.ts"; await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI); const email="appzonix@gmail.com"; if (await User.exists({ email })) { console.log("Account already exists; no changes made."); } else { const ownerName="Local Test User"; const passwordHash=await bcrypt.hash("123456789012",12); const user=await User.create({ ownerName, email, passwordHash, termsAcceptedAt:new Date(), emailVerifiedAt:new Date() }); try { await Shop.create({ ownerId:user._id, slug:`local-test-${Date.now()}`, displayName:"Local Test Shop", ownerName, mobile:"0000000000", email }); console.log("Local test account and shop created."); } catch (error) { await User.deleteOne({ _id:user._id }); throw error; } } await mongoose.disconnect();'
